target_customer: Large electricity consumers: industrials, retailers and data centers
problem: Large power buyers struggle to procure cheap and reliable electricity and manage hedging, reporting and capex screening across volatile markets.
business_model: B2B SaaS for energy management and procurement

founders.name: Jean Costa de Beauregard
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on hydropower plants with Clement Grivel. Employers and education not stated.

founders.name: Clément Grivel
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on hydropower plants with Jean. Employers and education not stated.

founders.name: Florian Pérocheau
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a former equity quant and power trader. Employers not named.

competitors.name: Gridmatic
competitors.what: AI-enabled power marketer with a retail arm for C&I customers
competitors.traction_then: Signed a 10MW PPA serving EdgeConneX in 2025

competitors.name: Arcadia Enterprise Solutions
competitors.what: Energy management platform covering data, payments, procurement and reporting for businesses

competitors.name: Trawa
competitors.what: Berlin AI renewable energy buying platform for SMEs

technical_complexity.rationale: Forecasting, hedging analytics and market data integration are standard but domain heavy, and the team has energy physics and trading skills.

defensibility.rationale: Dashboards and reporting are copyable, though data integration and ISO 27001 certification add some stickiness.

market_need_then: Data center and industrial power demand was rising and electricity prices volatile, creating spend on procurement optimization.

branding.domain_note: Uses condor.energy, a descriptive TLD domain

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, benefit-driven and concise, with slogans like Energy, under control

brand_strength.rationale: Clean name but shared with Condor Energies Inc., a listed oil and gas firm, which causes search confusion. No brand press.

outcome_analysis: Condor Energy is an active W26 company with no exit, shutdown or layoffs found. The founders have power trading and energy physics backgrounds, giving founder market fit, and data center load growth is a tailwind. Competition from Gridmatic, Arcadia and others is real.
notes: Funding: aggregators (PitchBook, VCBacked) report about 500K USD total, a March 2026 early-stage round and investors Frst Capital, Kima Ventures and Source Ventures. Aggregator only, unverified, so not recorded as a round. Company site says backed by Y Combinator and Bpifrance. Outcome searches mostly returned Condor Energies Inc., an unrelated Calgary oil and gas company.
